description: Tony's native Zig TensorFold TP4 lane at 9fa230d3eb119f588e690bf9b87ce41ed902db60, with the pinned bertholomus engine/kit and the creator's sampling, Triton/indexer and rank-cache patches. Full 1M context, 16 streams, built-in DSpark, image input and byte-checked chat template. Engram shards stay on local NVMe. Read-only source weights derive a per-rank cache and verified RoPE/vision kit under /outputs/cache; restart reuses valid completed work and rebuilds incomplete or malformed derived inputs. The 100 GB head peak estimate allows the creator's 71.87 GiB resident model plus serving overhead (28-29 GiB available on the head). Upstream measurements are not physical qualification on this fleet.
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 EXL3 3.5bpw TensorFold TP4 (tonyd2wild)
